tests.goal: Small native action-conditioned rollout; not task-success evaluation
Baseline versus recorded RGB; inspect gripper, bottle, packets and scanner
Different robot domain; no cross-domain action substitution
Review actual per-row robot/camera domain transitions
Per-second continuity and identity review; no predeclared collapse threshold
Official generic human-motion control baseline; not a robot sample
Robot-specific RGB controls; compare arm, gripper, bottle and tabletop geometry
After baseline success: change lighting/material text while preserving controls; assess geometric leakage

deferred: Action counterfactuals require calibrated semantic trajectories; do not equate normalized all-zero vectors with stopping.
Robot depth/seg tests require real simulator or calibrated rendered GT; do not relabel edge/grayscale as metric depth.
Closed-loop policy tests require observation-to-action feedback and separate state/physics validation.
